mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_attempt(exam_code, student_id, status, answers_json, started_at, submitted_at) VALUES (#{examCode}, #{studentId}, #{status}, #{answersJson}, #{startedAt}, #{submittedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id as attemptId, exam_code as examCode, student_id as studentId, status, answers_json as answersJson, started_at as startedAt, submitted_at as submittedAt FROM exam_attempt WHERE exam_code = #{examCode} AND student_id = #{studentId}
